Calculate the half-day (day or night) temperature component (terra version)

Source: R/temperature_terra.R
calculate_halfday_component_terra.Rd

Calculate the half-day (day or night) temperature component (terra version)

Usage

calculate_halfday_component_terra(
  r,
  reference_period,
  part_of_day,
  extremum,
  percentile,
  above_thresholds,
  mask_path = NULL,
  threshold = 0.8,
  cores = 1L,
  target_chunk_gb = 1
)

Arguments

r

A terra::SpatRaster, hourly resolution, temperature already in the desired unit (e.g. Celsius), with terra::time() set. Non masque : le masquage se fait ici, une fois les donnees reduites (voir note ci-dessous).

reference_period

Character vector c("YYYY-MM-DD", "YYYY-MM-DD").

part_of_day

"day" or "night".

extremum

"min" or "max".

percentile

Numeric percentile (e.g. 90 or 10).

above_thresholds

Logical. TRUE counts days above the threshold (hot extremes); FALSE counts days below (cold extremes).

mask_path

Path to the mask NetCDF file, or NULL (no masking).

threshold

Numeric threshold for the mask. Default 0.8.

cores

Passed to calculate_percentiles_terra()'s own cores (see its performance note) – the rolling-window percentile step is by far the most expensive part of this function. Default 1 (sequential, identical to previous behaviour).

target_chunk_gb

Passed to temp_extremum_terra() / resample_daily_terra() (see its memory note) for memory-safe temporal chunking of large hourly series.

Value

Same structure as calculate_halfday_component(): list(data, time, lon, lat).
